result.releaseSummary: This release introduces a floating agent companion UI for authenticated admin and editor users, with persistent per-user preferences and responsive/mobile support. The backend API enforces strict access controls, supports preference storage (local or Netlify Blob), and ensures no agent execution is possible from the companion. The UI is tested on desktop and physical iPhone Safari, with Android hardware testing deferred. Negative API tests confirm robust permission enforcement, including cross-origin, role, and session changes. No schema, environment, or data migration changes are present. Rollback is a simple revert.

result.cursorFixPrompt: Before merge, physical Android hardware QA must be performed for the floating companion UI. Test on Android Chrome (and Firefox if available): open/close, minimise/reopen, drag, keyboard show/hide, input/send visibility, zoom, saved preferences, and one scoped conversational reply. Capture screenshots and browser/device versions. If any controls are inaccessible or major UI bugs are found, revert the companion release and redeploy the previous main commit. Attach evidence to the release ticket. No other blocking issues found.
